specifications.purpose: Present a small mutually exclusive set of richly described choices.
useWhen: A single choice needs descriptive comparison.
doNotUseWhen: A compact label-only view switch is sufficient.

keyboard: Arrow keys select adjacent enabled choices.
Home and End select the boundary choices.
responsive: Compact density is the default contract.

naming: Label, helper text, and required state are associated with the group.
focus: One enabled option participates in the tab order and exposes a visible focus ring.
manualChecks: Verify long content, theme contrast, reflow, and product-context target size.

evidence.visual: Documentation route exists; a dedicated visual fixture remains a tracked rollout gap.

limitations: Only two and three-column layouts are supported.
